stores.loader: LakeSourceBindings (compiled from the files the release pins)
stores.verification: sector_brain_platform.knowledge_release: per-file sha256 and bytes plus release digest over the binding sources (CI --check); the binary compiles exactly those files
stores.lineage: bindingVersion in state provenance; knowledgeRelease in the artifact lineage once the artifact entry records it (Sector_Ops #48, before G7)

stores.verification: pointer -> release fingerprint, researchVersion and rowCount; vocabulary, assessed-species and directory checks
stores.lineage: presence fingerprint and sourceRef in the presence records

knowledge.notes: Level baselines in gs://sector-lake-brain are derived operational state rebuilt from observations, not approved knowledge. A missing presence pointer writes no presence; a refused release records presenceError.

knowledgeLoading.approved: reviewed-bindings (COMPILED_IN_BINARY, brains/lake/runtime/knowledge-release.json `lake-knowledge-2026-11-25.1`; approval PENDING (NOT_RECORDED): docs/cortex/approvals/lake-knowledge-2026-11-25.1.md; previous `lake-knowledge-2026-11-24.1` APPROVED 2026-11-25 (Sector_Ops #51 comment 7154041302); previous `lake-knowledge-2026-11-22.3` was APPROVED 2026-11-23, Sector_Ops #51 comment 7089961733)

operations.internalExecution: lake-brain Cloud Run job, lake-brain-ledger-daily Cloud Scheduler (validation exception), pilot lakes

execution.refresh: daily prospective ledger run (pilots); due when 26 h old
execution.controlledBy: fam.control-execution-control (global + per-Brain; fail closed; read by the orchestrator only)
